import ctypes
import numpy as np

# Load the dynamic libraries in the correct order
ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

# Define the Python callback for the function f(x)
@ctypes.CFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_void_p)
def f(x, params):
    return 0.25 if x < 0.5 else 0.75

def compute_chebyshev_approximations():
    # Allocate memory for the Chebyshev series
    gsl.gsl_cheb_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p)
    cs = gsl.gsl_cheb_alloc(40)

    # Define the gsl_function structure
    class GSLFunction(ctypes.Structure):
        _fields_ = [("function", ctypes.CFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_void_p)),
                    ("params", ctypes.c_void_p)]

    F = GSLFunction(function=f, params=None)

    # Initialize the Chebyshev series
    gsl.gsl_cheb_init(cs, ctypes.byref(F), ctypes.c_double(0.0), ctypes.c_double(1.0))

    # Prepare the results list
    results = []
    n = 10000

    # Define the evaluation functions
    gsl.gsl_cheb_eval_n.restype = ctypes.c_double
    gsl.gsl_cheb_eval.restype = ctypes.c_double

    for i in range(n):
        x = i / n
        r10 = gsl.gsl_cheb_eval_n(cs, 10, ctypes.c_double(x))
        r40 = gsl.gsl_cheb_eval(cs, ctypes.c_double(x))
        results.append((x, f(x, None), r10, r40))

    # Free the Chebyshev series memory
    gsl.gsl_cheb_free(cs)

    return results

def assert_test():
    results = compute_chebyshev_approximations()

    # Check the length of the results
    assert len(results) == 10000, "The results should contain 10000 entries."

    # Check the first and last entries for correctness
    assert results[0][0] == 0.0, "The first x value should be 0.0."
    assert results[-1][0] == 0.9999, "The last x value should be close to 1.0."

    # Check the function values for a few points
    assert results[0][1] == 0.25, "f(0.0) should be 0.25."
    assert results[5000][1] == 0.75, "f(0.5) should be 0.75."
    assert results[-1][1] == 0.75, "f(1.0) should be 0.75."

    print("All tests passed.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
